packageRules.description: lints/flutter_lints 6.x require Dart ^3.8 while the packages declare ^3.6. CI would stay green (the runner SDK is newer), silently breaking the declared support range, so majors need a deliberate SDK bump first.
act_thumbhash is this repository's own package; its constraint in act_thumbhash_flutter is bumped by hand as part of each release.
